description: Up to 20 Robinhood Chain coins in one call, answered only from checks Toll already holds (read in the last 24 h): for each coin the verdict word (AGAINST / CAREFUL / CLEAR / INCOMPLETE) with its tally and how old the read is, or "not read yet". Reads nothing new and uses no free coin. For a coin not read yet, call check_coin or pre_buy_check.
